lines: #Most people are *one* bad day away from disaster.
One broken car. One surprise *bill.* One lost job.
#And when it happens, everything *collapses.*
Panic. Borrowing. *Stress* that keeps you awake.
#A safety cushion changes *everything.*
It's not exciting money. You won't post it *online.*
But it's the money that buys you *peace.*
When something breaks, it's an *inconvenience.* Not a crisis.
When a bad boss pushes you, you have the freedom to *walk.*
It's the difference between *choosing*, and being forced.
Between sleeping at night, and staring at the *ceiling.*
#Start small. Even a little each week *counts.*
Put it somewhere separate. Somewhere you won't be *tempted.*
Don't touch it for wants. Only for real *emergencies.*
#Build it slowly. Build it *quietly.*
Treat it like a bill you pay to your future *self.*
Automatic. Non-negotiable. *Every* month.
And one day, life will throw something at you.
And you'll just handle it. *Calmly.*
That's what *real* security feels like.
end: Save this and start your cushion this week.
